configurations.name: Curl: Send Template to Email
configurations.command: cd ${workspaceFolder} && bash scripts/set-env.sh --dir server/curl api_key email template_id && bash server/curl/send-template-to-email.sh

configurations.name: Curl: Send Template to User ID
configurations.command: cd ${workspaceFolder} && bash scripts/set-env.sh --dir server/curl api_key user_id template_id && bash server/curl/send-template-to-user-id.sh

configurations.name: Curl: Generate JWT
configurations.command: cd ${workspaceFolder} && bash scripts/set-env.sh --dir server/curl api_key user_id && bash server/curl/generate-jwt.sh

configurations.name: React: Inbox
configurations.command: cd ${workspaceFolder} && bash scripts/set-env.sh --dir web/react/inbox api_key user_id jwt && cd web/react/inbox && npm i && npm run dev

configurations.name: React: Toast
configurations.command: cd ${workspaceFolder} && bash scripts/set-env.sh --dir web/react/toast api_key user_id jwt && cd web/react/toast && npm i && npm run dev -- --open

configurations.name: React: Popup Menu
configurations.command: cd ${workspaceFolder} && bash scripts/set-env.sh --dir web/react/popup-menu api_key user_id jwt && cd web/react/popup-menu && npm i && npm run dev
